The main takeaway from our work is that

, when the owner of items is willing to assist the selection mechanism by providing the ranking of the selected items, the mechanism can leverage this additional information to improve the selection performance.
, in certain settings, the owner of the items can improve the quality of the selection process by assisting the mechanism with information that she knows but the reviewers do not.
a mechanism that takes advantage of information from both the reviewers and the owner is more efficient than one that only uses the information from the reviewers.
